| | | | |

## Integration

- [ ] The canonical issue records the current owner, dependencies and delivery state.
- [ ] Focused regressions and applicable policy/docs gates are recorded without weakening acceptance.
- [ ] Owning progress/documentation and a unique changelog fragment are updated.
- [ ] Shared consumers and merge order are accounted for; derived files come from their generator.

Use `Refs #N` for a child PR. Use `Closes #N` only when the complete declared
scope can close on integration into main. A branch result does not establish
parent-phase, whole-workspace or licensed acceptance.
